description: This file provides utility functions for tenant management in a frontend application, including tenant ID normalization, active tenant retrieval and setting via localStorage, fetching session tenants, and selecting a tenant via API calls.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Extracts a tenant id from various tenant-like structures or strings.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from localStorage, with backward compatibility.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in localStorage, cleaning up legacy keys.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from client-side storage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches the list of authorized tenants for the current user via API.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant via backend API and updates localStorage and UI hints.
